# CodePipeline execution and release automation

**Status: proposed.** This service or extension is not implemented in the registered API profiles.
The scope below is a design candidate, without an assigned version or delivery date.

## First useful slice

Extend records-only pipeline declarations to executions, stage transitions, approvals and triggers.

## Proposed scope

- [ ] StartPipelineExecution, GetPipelineExecution, ListPipelineExecutions and StopPipelineExecution
- [ ] Stage transitions, retry and rollback of stage executions
- [ ] Manual approval results and action executions
- [ ] Triggers, stage conditions and source change detection
- [ ] Webhooks, jobs and custom action types
- [ ] Retained pipeline versions

## Integration decisions

The current CodePipeline API stores pipeline declarations and tags only; nothing runs, so pipeline state lists stages and actions without executions.
